affected_subject.reason: Identifies GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory, Launchpad, and GTELaunchpadV2Pair as affected components.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete action: attacker front-runs by calling createPair before graduation, causing PAIR_EXISTS and launchpad adopting attacker's pair.

direct_effect.reason: Pair initialized with launchpadFeeDistributor=address(0), so launchpadFee0/1=0 and no rewards accrue to stakers.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected rewards accrual for stakers vs actual zero fees when pair created by non-launchpad, establishing authorization/state-transition safety relation.

summary: All four dimensions are supported: affected contracts, front-running trigger, zero-fee/no-reward effect, and expected-vs-actual rewards accrual relation are all grounded in fragments.
